identity_directory.title: User sync — {provider}
identity_directory.intro: Optional. Keeps this console's user list in step with your identity provider: people exist, with their groups and pre-assigned access, before their first sign-in, and are deactivated when removed there. You don't need this to add users — people appear at their first sign-in.
identity_directory.just_in_time.title: Just-in-time only
identity_directory.just_in_time.body: A {kind} provider offers no way to list its users: OIDC itself has no listing API. People appear here when they first sign in.
identity_directory.adapter.label: How this directory tells us about people
identity_directory.adapter.none: Off (default) — people appear at their first sign-in
identity_directory.adapter.authelia_file: Authelia users file (not needed: the Users page manages bundled accounts)
identity_directory.adapter.keycloak_admi: Keycloak admin API — pulled on a schedule (service-account client)
identity_directory.adapter.scim: SCIM 2.0 — your identity provider pushes changes here
identity_directory.pull_every.label: Pull every (minutes)
identity_directory.pull_every.hint: 0 means only when run from here.
identity_directory.keycloak.client_secre: Stored encrypted, never shown again. Saving it makes the next run a dry run.
identity_directory.scim.body: Give the identity provider's provisioning settings this endpoint and a token. Map the person's object id to {#code}externalId{/code} so accounts can exist before their first sign-in.
identity_directory.runs.first_run_title: The first run is a dry run
identity_directory.runs.first_run_body: Nothing changes until you have looked at what the adapter would do and confirmed it. A run that would deactivate more than max(5, 10%) of this directory's accounts always stops for confirmation.
identity_directory.pending.all_accounted: Everyone the directory lists has an account.
admin_identity.join_mode.open.label: Open
admin_identity.join_mode.open.hint: Anyone who signs in through the identity provider gets an active account at once.
admin_identity.join_mode.approval.label: Approval
admin_identity.join_mode.approval.hint: A first-time sign-in creates a disabled account in the Users page's Awaiting-approval queue; you enable the people you want.
admin_identity.join_mode.invite.label: Invite
admin_identity.join_mode.invite.hint: Only people you invited (or a directory pushed) can sign in. Everyone else is refused.
admin_identity.join_mode.group.label: Group
admin_identity.join_mode.group.hint: Only members of the required groups may sign in — checked at every sign-in and every API call.
admin_identity.load_error.title: Could not load the identity policy
admin_identity.join_mode_note: Join mode {source}. Administrators are never refused by this gate, so a wrong group cannot lock you out.
admin_identity.needs_groups.title: Pick at least one required group first
admin_identity.needs_groups.body: A group gate with no groups refuses everyone who is not an administrator — including the account that would fix it.
admin_identity.group.unmapped: No IdP group maps to this: only members added here or by SCIM count.
admin_identity.group.none: No groups yet. An identity provider's name must first be mapped on the Groups page.
admin_identity.fallback.label: Someone without a required group
admin_identity.fallback.hint.refuse: They are refused and told to ask an administrator.
admin_identity.fallback.hint.approval: Their account is created disabled, waiting in the approval queue.
